# AI discovery & project overview file
# https://llmstxt.org (community convention)

project: Identity Platform – Django IdP + FastAPI Gateway
owner: Blandskron SpA
author: Bastián Landskron
year: 2026
license: MIT

summary:
This repository contains an internal identity and authentication platform.
It combines a Django-based Identity Provider (session + CSRF, no JWT)
with a FastAPI Gateway that issues JWT access/refresh tokens while
validating the real session against Django.

primary-language:
- Python

frameworks:
- Django
- Django REST Framework
- FastAPI

architecture:
- Monorepo
- Docker Compose
- Microservices
- Session-based authentication (Django)
- JWT Gateway (RS256)

services:
- django-idp:
    role: Identity Provider (source of truth)
    auth: session cookies + CSRF
    database: PostgreSQL
    endpoints:
      - /api/auth/login
      - /api/auth/register
      - /api/auth/me
      - /api/auth/logout
      - /api/auth/csrf

- fastapi-gateway:
    role: Authentication Gateway
    auth: JWT (access + refresh)
    validation: refresh requires active Django session
    endpoints:
      - /api/v1/login
      - /api/v1/register
      - /api/v1/me
      - /api/v1/refresh
      - /api/v1/logout

security-model:
- Django sessions are the source of truth
- JWT is derived, not authoritative
- Refresh token requires:
  - valid JWT
  - active Django session
  - matching user identity
- Logout revokes the session centrally

cookies:
- sessionid (HttpOnly)
- csrftoken

jwt:
- algorithm: RS256
- issuer: fastapi-gateway
- audience: clients
- signed-by: private key (gateway)

documentation:
- README.md        : high-level overview
- DOCS.md          : detailed technical documentation
- docker-compose.yml : full local stack

intended-use:
- Internal platforms
- Educational environments
- Corporate / B2B architectures
- Not a public OAuth provider

not-included:
- OAuth2 / OpenID Connect
- Public user CRUD
- JWT-only authentication
- Public SaaS auth flows

contact:
- company: Blandskron SpA
- maintainer: Bastián Landskron
